route: TU Wien / TU Graz English MSc, public technical universities
tuition: €726.72/semester for non-EU (≈€1,453/yr) + ÖH union fee ≈€25/semester (TU Wien official). TU Graz same national rate.
visaFunds: Residence permit 'Student' (2026 rates): €722.58/month if under 24, €1,308.39/month if 24 or older, for 12 months (≈€8.7k vs ≈€15.7k), plus extra if rent > €386.43/month; health insurance ≈€78.84/month
english: TU Graz: certificate needed (TOEFL/IELTS/PTE/Cambridge/telc). An English-taught degree counts only from EU/EEA, UK, US, CA, AU, NZ, SG, ZA, CH, so a Pakistani MOI letter is NOT accepted. TU Wien: B2 required; whether it accepts an MOI letter is unconfirmed (email admission)
postStudy: 12-month residence extension for job search after graduation, then Red-White-Red Card (graduates of Austrian universities get a simplified route)
fitReason: Very cheap tuition. If he is under 24 on application, funds proof (≈€8.7k) fits easily; at 24+ it is ≈€15.7k, slightly above the blocked-account budget. IELTS likely needed for TU Graz; Vienna has moderate English-only tech jobs.
keyDeadlines: TU Graz (third-country nationals, winter semester): 1 May – 15 Aug 2027 window; TU Wien international master applications typically spring 2027. Apply early because the visa takes 2–3 months.
programmes: TU Wien MSc Data Science (English)
TU Wien MSc Logic and Computation (English)
TU Graz MSc Computer Science (English)
TU Graz MSc Software Engineering and Management (English)
JKU Linz MSc Artificial Intelligence (English)

route: ETH Zurich / EPFL MSc (English), federal institutes of technology
tuition: CHF 2,190/semester for foreign students starting from autumn 2025 (tripled from CHF 730); application fee CHF 150 (ETH)
visaFunds: About CHF 21,000/yr in Zurich/Vaud cantons (bank statement or guarantee); scholarship letter counts
english: ETH: TOEFL/IELTS/CAE/CPE, OR an official confirmation from the university central administration that the ENTIRE bachelor's was taught only in English (a FAST registrar MOI letter can work if worded exactly). EPFL: check the programme page; usually C1 level, test often required
postStudy: 6-month job-search permit after a Swiss degree; then a work permit with non-EU quotas, though Swiss graduates in shortage fields have some priority
fitReason: Without ESOP/EPFL fellowship the living costs far exceed €14–17k. ESOP/EPFL needs top ~10% of class; CGPA 3.41 is unlikely to be competitive. Worth one long-shot ETH application only if FAST rank is high. GRE is required only for some programmes.
keyDeadlines: ETH ESOP (autumn 2027 MSc): 1–30 Nov 2026, 11:59 CET (official). ETH regular MSc: Nov–Dec 2026 (check programme). EPFL: mid-Nov to 15 Dec 2026 (recommended for visa applicants) or by 31 Mar 2027.

route: Public university / IDEX MSc (English) via Campus France Pakistan 'Études en France'
tuition: Non-EU differentiated master's fee €3,950/yr in 2026-27 (Decree 2026-385); universities may exempt up to 30% of internationals in 2026-27 and 25% in 2027-28. Grandes écoles (IP Paris) €6–20k+
visaFunds: €615/month (≈€7,380/yr) plus tuition; scholarships count
english: Set by each programme: many need IELTS 6.0–6.5; some accept an MOI letter. Campus France Pakistan handles all non-PhD study visas via EEF (a paid service with an interview)
postStudy: Master's graduates get a 12-month 'APS'/job-search residence permit (carte recherche d'emploi ou création d'entreprise), then a salarié or Talent permit
fitReason: €3,950 tuition + €7,380 funds proof fits the budget. There are strong AI programmes (Saclay, Grenoble MIAI, Nice), and the IDEX scholarships are realistic routes. Paris AI startups often work in English, though French helps elsewhere. Check each programme's IELTS/MOI rule.
keyDeadlines: Eiffel: schools nominate by 6 Jan 2027, with internal deadlines from Oct–Nov 2026. Paris-Saclay scholarship: coordinators select by about 25 Mar 2027. Most M1/M2 portals close Jan–Apr 2027. Campus France EEF in spring 2027.
programmes: Université Paris-Saclay M2 Artificial Intelligence / Data Science
